name: core-truth-neutrality
description: The distinction the version exists for: a Proposition existing is not the Proposition being true. A tuple carries no confidence, the same tuple resolves to one Proposition, and a raw read reports claims rather than beliefs.

cases.name: a local predicate name is persisted as its exact symbol
a Concept's type is persisted as its exact symbol
ENSURE resolves the same tuple rather than duplicating it
a new element starts at version 1
an unknown type is refused, never invented
an Assertion's epistemic payload cannot be edited
cases.command: UPDATE ?a SET FIELDS { confidence: 0.1 } WHERE { ?a ASSERTION {} }

cases.name: a reference slot carries the name and the shape the Specification fixes
a citation is {id, role}, under the slot named evidence
a Proposition carries no author-writable attribute bag
cases.command: UPDATE ?p SET ATTRIBUTES { note: "about the tuple" } WHERE { ?p PROPOSITION (?s, "prefers", ?o) }

cases.name: a stance the Core Package does not name is refused, bound parameter or not
confidence is epistemic support in [0, 1] at both ends
an Evidence citation role comes from the Core registry
and so does an Activity status, whether it is written or bound
a CLIENT KEY makes a resend a retry rather than a second creation

Option.description: A preference option used by these fixtures. A real Space types each option by its kind (Profile §5.5, §7), because prefers partitions by the option's Concept Type; one catch-all type is one partition.
